title: Two distinct α2β1 integrin glycan interactions mediate cell entry of a picornavirus
task: Identify integrin α2β1 and its glycan interactions as receptors for equine rhinitis A virus entry
key_results: CRISPRi screen identified integrin α2β1; virus binds closed-conformation α2 β-propeller independent of divalent cations; binds high-mannose glycan at α2 N112 and sialylated glycan at β1 N269; both glycan interactions required for infection
comments: Dual glycan-protein interaction mechanism represents a sophisticated viral adaptation to receptor diversity, with implications for understanding picornavirus tropism.

model_io.model: HEK293T cells and equine fibroblasts; cryo-EM analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: ERAV binds divalent cation-dependent integrin epitope
hypotheses.result: Refuted; binding is independent of divalent cations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Glycan interactions are required for viral entry
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; glycan knockout and mutant studies demonstrated importance of both glycans

title: Tau monomers and fibrils escape microglial clearance via distinct cellular mechanisms
task: Elucidate distinct microglial trafficking mechanisms for tau monomers versus fibrils
key_results: Tau monomers internalized via LRP1 but recycled back extracellularly without lysosomal degradation; tau fibrils adhere to surface via HSPG-dependent TLR4 activation, triggering pro-inflammatory cytokine release; APOE variants reduce tau uptake
comments: Demonstrates mechanistic divergence in microglial responses to tau conformers, with implications for understanding tau propagation in neurodegeneration.

model_io.model: Human iPSC-derived microglia

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tau monomers are efficiently degraded in lysosomes after LRP1-mediated uptake
hypotheses.result: Refuted; monomers recycled back to extracellular space without degradation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tau fibrils are internalized similarly to monomers
hypotheses.result: Refuted; fibrils remain surface-bound via HSPG and trigger TLR4-mediated activation

title: Positional replication fork instability drives PARP inhibitor cytotoxicity
task: Determine positional replication fork instability as mechanism of PARP inhibitor cytotoxicity
key_results: ESCO2 loss confers PARPi hypersensitivity independent of HR deficiency; G-quadruplex structures accumulate at ESCO2-deficient replication forks in pericentromeric regions; G4–PARP1–TIMELESS–DDX11 axis protects fork stability; PARPi disrupts this protection
comments: Reveals position-specific (pericentromeric) vulnerability and elegant G4-processing safeguard mechanism; suggests ESCO2 as synthetic lethal partner with PARPi beyond classical HR-deficient contexts.

model_io.model: CRISPR screens and single-molecule imaging in cancer cells; genomic analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: ESCO2 loss confers PARPi sensitivity only in HR-deficient cells
hypotheses.result: Refuted; ESCO2 loss confers PARPi hypersensitivity independent of HR status

hypotheses.hypothesis: G4-PARP1-TIMELESS-DDX11 axis is critical for fork stability at hard-to-replicate loci
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; loss of any component increases fork instability

title: Dingxiang Guanshitong suppresses ESCC progression by modulating TAK1/NF-κB/GLUT1-associated glycolytic reprogramming
task: Elucidate mechanism by which traditional Chinese herbal formulation DGST suppresses ESCC through glycolytic reprogramming
key_results: DGST suppresses TAK1 phosphorylation, reduces IκBα and p65 phosphorylation, decreases GLUT1/HK2/PFKP/LDHA expression, reduces ATP levels; TAK1 knockdown enhances DGST effects; DGST suppresses tumor growth, proliferation, migration by ~60–80%
comments: Network pharmacology approach identifies TAK1/NF-κB/GLUT1 axis, though individual DGST constituents and their relative contributions remain to be fully elucidated.

model_io.model: 4NQO-induced ESCC mouse model and TE-1 cancer cells with TAK1 knockdown/overexpression

hypotheses.hypothesis: DGST suppresses ESCC by modulating TAK1/NF-κB axis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; TAK1 knockdown enhanced DGST efficacy

hypotheses.hypothesis: Glycolytic reprogramming is downstream of TAK1/NF-κB
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; GLUT1 and glycolytic enzyme expression reduced via TAK1 modulation

title: Adipose derived small extracellular vesicles improve spermatogenesis and fertility in a mouse model of azoospermia compared with stem cell and combination therapies
task: Compare efficacy of adipose-derived MSCs, MSC-derived sEVs, and their combination in restoring spermatogenesis in non-obstructive azoospermia
key_results: AD-MSC-sEVs superior to MSCs and combination therapy in spermatogenesis gene expression, hormone profiles, and sperm quality; fertility restored in AD-MSC-sEV group; no GFP-positive spermatozoa or F1 transgene detected
comments: Cell-free sEV approach shows superior efficacy and raises safety considerations regarding germ-line transmission that were appropriately tested.

model_io.model: Busulfan-induced NOA mouse model with testicular injection

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combination of AD-MSCs and sEVs provides superior regeneration
hypotheses.result: Refuted; AD-MSC-sEVs alone were most effective

hypotheses.hypothesis: GFP-marked cells or their products integrate into germ line
hypotheses.result: Refuted; no GFP signal in spermatozoa or F1 offspring

title: Weak electromagnetic field configuration differentially shapes cellular redox and metabolic responses
task: Determine whether weak electromagnetic field configuration modulates cellular redox and metabolic responses
key_results: Sweep field (SF) induced redox-partitioned response with increased extracellular H₂O₂; radiofrequency (RF) increased cytosolic NAD⁺/NADH ratio and reduced lactate; full tNMR showed modest mitochondrial MitoSOX increase; respiratory and glycolytic stress parameters remained comparable
comments: Field configuration emerges as key determinant of cellular response, but functional consequences and mechanistic transducers remain unclear.

model_io.model: NIH3T3 cells exposed to hypoxia-reoxygenation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Field intensity alone determines cellular redox response
hypotheses.result: Refuted; field configuration is key determinant

hypotheses.hypothesis: Distinct field components produce distinct metabolic profiles
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SF, RF, and tNMR each produced unique redox-metabolic signatures

title: A tumor-associated K318N variant abolishes AGGF1 nuclear import by disrupting key nucleocytoplasmic transport motifs
task: Identify nucleocytoplasmic transport motifs for AGGF1 and characterize K318N tumor variant
key_results: Three regulatory motifs identified (272–279, 317–328, 509–519 aa); importin α1/β1 complex is primary import receptor; K318N variant causes cytoplasmic mislocalization, abrogates p53 binding and transcriptional activation
comments: K318N demonstrates how a single nucleotide variant can disrupt nuclear localization and tumor-suppression function, though broader cancer prevalence data are limited.

model_io.model: Cell-based assay with deletion mapping and GST pull-down

hypotheses.hypothesis: K318N is associated with enhanced nuclear export or 14-3-3 binding
hypotheses.result: Refuted; cytoplasmic mislocalization is import-deficient, not export-dependent

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combined 272–328 aa region is sufficient for robust nuclear import
hypotheses.result: Confirmed

title: MR imaging and spectroscopy reveals metabolic changes in glioblastoma driven by treatment with temozolomide and lonidamine
task: Evaluate metabolic effects of lonidamine combined with temozolomide in glioblastoma using MR imaging and spectroscopy
key_results: LND + TMZ reduced lactate pool and MCT4 expression; acute decrease in mitochondrial respiration followed by partial recovery; modest survival benefit with no significant differences in tumor volume or DWI parameters after 6 days
comments: Early metabolic changes are detectable but limited therapeutic efficacy at early timepoints suggests need for longer-term studies and optimized dosing strategies.

model_io.model: Syngeneic GL261 glioblastoma model and primary cell culture

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lonidamine reduces glycolytic flux and lactate production
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; significant decrease in lactate and MCT4 reduction in LND treatment groups

hypotheses.hypothesis: LND + TMZ combination provides significant survival benefit
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; enhanced but not statistically significant survival benefit observed

title: MSCs-derived exosomes attenuate cadmium-induced hepatotoxicity by suppressing mitochondria-dependent ferroptosis
task: Determine mechanisms by which MSC-derived exosomes protect liver from cadmium-induced ferroptosis
key_results: MSCs-Exos reverse mitochondrial fragmentation and membrane potential loss; reduce ROS and iron accumulation; restore ferroptosis regulator expression; in vivo homing to injured liver and reduction of liver enzymes by ~50%
comments: Therapeutic exosome approach shows promise but mechanism of hepatic targeting and optimal dosing require further investigation.

model_io.model: Cadmium-exposed hepatocytes and liver tissue (in vitro and in vivo mouse model)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cadmium triggers mitochondria-dependent ferroptosis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; characterized by fragmentation, membrane potential loss, antioxidant depletion

hypotheses.hypothesis: MSCs-Exos suppress ferroptosis by restoring mitochondrial integrity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; reversed multiple ferroptosis hallmarks

title: Lactylation couples glycolysis with cell cycle progression in cancer cells
task: Establish lactate-dependent Aurora B activation as a coupling mechanism between glycolysis and cell cycle progression
key_results: Lactate promotes KAT2A-mediated PGK1 lactylation at K131; lactylated PGK1 phosphorylates Aurora B at T232; PGK1 K131R mutant impairs mitotic progression and activates cGAS–STING; combining PGK1–Aurora B disruptor with anti-PD-1 enhances CD8+ infiltration
comments: Elegant metabolic-epigenetic coupling mechanism with immunotherapeutic implications; demonstrates glycolysis as upstream regulator of mitotic fidelity.

model_io.model: Cancer cell lines and mouse tumor model; immunotherapy combination study

hypotheses.hypothesis: Aurora B activity is independent of metabolic state
hypotheses.result: Refuted; Aurora B is activated through lactate-dependent PGK1 lactylation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Disrupting PGK1–Aurora B interaction impairs tumor growth
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; leads to mitotic defects and cGAS–STING activation

title: Energy-guided combinatorial co-optimization of antibody affinity and stability
task: Co-optimize antibody affinity and stability through energy-guided combinatorial mutagenesis
key_results: 30-fold affinity gain while maintaining stability; 10-fold improvement in small-scale screening of drug-target antibodies; diverse high-mutational-load variants identified rather than single optimum
comments: Excellent demonstration of avoiding affinity-stability trade-offs, though mechanism preventing convergence to single sequence remains unexplained.

model_io.model: LAffAb: structure-based energy optimization generating combinatorial library
outputs: 7000 variant designs with predicted affinities and stabilities

hypotheses.hypothesis: Energy-guided mutagenesis can simultaneously improve affinity and stability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; up to 30-fold affinity gain achieved while co-optimizing stability

hypotheses.hypothesis: Optimization converges to single sequence solution
hypotheses.result: Refuted; library favored diverse variants with high mutational load

title: An information-theoretic framework for inferring T cell dynamics from single-cell RNA and T cell receptor sequencing
task: Infer joint T cell clonotype-phenotype distributions from paired scTCR and scRNA-seq data
key_results: TCRi computed mutual information (MI) between clonotype and phenotype from 167,118 CD8 T cells; MI emerged as robust discriminator of anti-PD-(L)1 response across four datasets from cancer patients
comments: Novel information-theoretic framework elegantly unifies clonotypic and phenotypic modeling; predictive utility demonstrated but mechanistic basis for MI-response association unclear.

model_io.model: TCRi: variational autoencoder + hierarchical Bayesian model computing clonotype-phenotype joint distributions
inputs: Paired single-cell TCR sequences and gene expression (CD8 T cells)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mutual information between clonotype and phenotype predicts anti-PD-(L)1 therapeutic response
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; MI discriminates responders across four datasets

title: Multiscale multimodal integration of spatial omics through a deep generative model with CORAL
task: Integrate spatial multi-omic datasets across modalities and studies using domain-invariant geometric learning
key_results: CORAL identified microvascular proliferation domain in glioblastoma, corrected cortical-layer annotations in Alzheimer's disease, resolved subtle mouse embryo structures; robust to missing data and unseen cell types; generated thymic T cell migration and splenic immune interactions from mouse Stereo-CITE-seq
comments: Elegant domain adaptation approach unifying vertical and horizontal integration; scalability to millions of cells demonstrated but tissue-type generalization unclear.

model_io.model: CORAL: geometric deep learning with domain-invariant representation learning and label transfer
inputs: Multi-omic spatial datasets (transcriptomic, proteomic, metabolomic, epigenomic)
Diverse tissues and platforms with batch effects/study-site differences

hypotheses.hypothesis: Domain-invariant embeddings enable cross-modal and cross-study cell-type annotation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; DIRAC identified novel structures (microvascular proliferation, migration patterns) and corrected annotations

title: Integration and annotation of spatial multi-omic data with DIRAC
task: Integrate and annotate spatial multi-omic data with domain adaptation learning for cell-type discovery
key_results: DIRAC identified microvascular proliferation in glioblastoma, corrected cortical-layer annotations in Alzheimer's disease, resolved embryonic structures; robust to missing data and unseen cell types; scales to millions of cells
comments: Duplicate of paper 14; same methodological approach and key results.

model_io.model: DIRAC: geometric deep learning with domain invariant representation and adaptive calibration
inputs: Batch effects, platform differences, study-site variations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Domain-invariant geometric learning enables cross-modal and cross-study cell annotation without dataset-specific retraining
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; DIRAC generalized across sequencing/imaging platforms and identified novel structures

title: Nitrogen-functionalized rigid 3D-spirochroman–cycloalkane hybrids as dual α-amylase and α-glucosidase inhibitors: synthesis, biological evaluation, and computational insights
task: Design dual α-amylase and α-glucosidase inhibitors for diabetes through rational synthesis and structure-activity relationships
key_results: Nicotinonitrile 6: IC50 = 21.3 µM (α-amylase, 3.7× better than acarbose); hydrazone 15: IC50 = 18.2 µM (α-glucosidase, 2.4× better than acarbose); hydrazone 12a most balanced (IC50 = 25.3/29.1 µM); minimal cytotoxicity (IC50 ≈ 316–612 µM)
comments: Solid medicinal chemistry with good potency improvements and ADMET optimization, but mechanism of dual inhibition and in vivo efficacy remain untested.

model_io.model: Molecular docking + ADMET prediction + DFT electronic structure analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nitrogen substitution modulates binding affinity through electronic structure effects
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; DFT shows N-substitution reduces HOMO-LUMO gap correlating with activity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Compounds maintain favorable drug-likeness vs acarbose
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ADMET predictions show improved GI absorption and bioavailability

title: A generative adversarial network-augmented dual-stream Mamba-transformer framework for advanced intrusion detection and cyber threat mitigation in smart healthcare networks
task: Detect advanced cyber threats in IoMT networks using dual-stream Mamba-Transformer with GAN augmentation
key_results: GAN-Mamba Former-IDS: 97.71% accuracy, 0.7901 macro-F1, 0.9842 ROC-AUC on 19-class CICIoMT2024; CTGAN augmentation improved minority-class macro-F1 by +0.2109; generalization across five IoT benchmarks confirmed
comments: Strong engineering combining state-space models with attention and class-balancing GANs; reproducibility bolstered by five random seeds but no external clinical network validation.

model_io.model: GAN-Mamba Former-IDS: Protocol-Aware Router + dual-stream Mamba-Transformer + CTGAN augmentation
inputs: IoMT network traffic with protocol-specific features partitioned into four groups

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dual-stream architecture capturing sequential (Mamba) and global (Transformer) dependencies improves IDS accuracy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outperforms MLP, CNN, BiLSTM, Transformer-only, Mamba-only baselines

hypotheses.hypothesis: CTGAN augmentation balances minority attack classes improving macro-F1
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; macro-F1 gains up to +0.2109 for rarest classes

title: AgriVision: adversarial image detection using Deep Learning in agricultural contexts
task: Detect and attribute synthetic agricultural images using deep learning across multiple generators
key_results: In-distribution: EfficientNet-B0/ResNet-50 near-saturated performance; CLIP weaker on binary authenticity. Out-of-distribution (unseen generators): accuracy drops for source attribution; CLIP shows plant-specific failures
comments: Honest assessment of generalization limits; demonstrates that current methods saturate on known generators but fail on novel diffusion/GAN variants.

model_io.model: AgriVision: EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50, and CLIP (ViT-B/32) classifiers
inputs: Apple/maize/tomato images (real, StyleGAN2, StyleGAN3, R3GAN, Instruct-Pix2Pix, BLIP-Diffusion, DreamShaper-8 synthetic)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Convolutional and vision-language models generalize to unseen generative sources
hypotheses.result: Refuted; accuracy drops on out-of-distribution generators; CLIP shows plant-specific failures

title: Domain-specific variants reshape terpene synthase conformational dynamics and ligand binding in Coffea arabica populations from Saudi Arabia
task: Characterize structural and dynamical consequences of TPS variants in Coffea arabica populations
key_results: p.Glu424Val altered ligand dynamics and Mg²⁺ coordination; 8-substitution construct reduced ligand RMSD (3.162 ± 0.743 vs 3.831 ± 0.273 Å) but did not meet statistical compensation criteria; TPS lid architecture showed stronger effect on ligand confinement
comments: Thorough molecular dynamics analysis undermined by lack of statistically supported epistatic compensation and absence of experimental validation.

model_io.model: Molecular dynamics simulations (300 ns × 3 replicates) and QM/MM analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Missense variants cause compensatory epistasis improving catalytic efficiency
hypotheses.result: Directional trend observed but not statistically supported (q=0.549)

hypotheses.hypothesis: TPS lid architecture strongly influences ligand dynamics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; lid-containing construct showed significantly lower ligand RMSD (q=0.011)

title: Multimodal deep learning with clinical metadata for skin lesion classification
task: Integrate skin images and clinical metadata for improved skin lesion classification
key_results: PAD-UFES-20: multimodal model 85.6% balanced accuracy vs 75.1% prior baseline; ISIC 2019: 86.0% balanced accuracy; PKU-Skin: 99.6% balanced accuracy (binary task)
comments: Substantial improvements but PKU-Skin binary classification and dataset-specific models limit external applicability; acknowledged lack of prospective validation.

model_io.model: Multimodal deep learning fusing images + clinical metadata
inputs: Three datasets: PAD-UFES-20 (2,298 images, 6 classes), ISIC 2019 (25,331 images, 8 classes), PKU-Skin (800 images, binary)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integrating clinical metadata improves classification over image-alone models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across all datasets; PAD-UFES-20 improvement 85.6% vs 75.1%

title: A dual-stream Pyramid ViT–ConvFormer architecture leverages dynamic early stopping to classify diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
task: Classify MYC-rearranged diffuse large B-cell lymphoma using hybrid Vision Transformer-ConvFormer architecture
key_results: PyConv achieved 0.9962 patch-level accuracy, 0.9999 macro AUROC, 100% (18/18) patient-level concordance on test set; 68.7% faster convergence than pure ViT (epoch 20 vs ~61)
comments: Impressive internal validation but exploratory proof-of-concept requiring multi-center/multi-scanner validation; small test cohort (18 patients) limits generalization claims.

model_io.model: PyConv: asymmetrical hybrid architecture with Pyramid ViT + ConvFormer blocks + MHCA fusion
inputs: Whole-slide images (180 WSI, 69,480 patches) annotated for MYC+ DLBCL, MYC- DLBCL, and RLN

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid ViT-ConvFormer integrating local and global context outperforms single-architecture backbones
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PyConv matched or exceeded 12 baselines with faster convergence

hypotheses.hypothesis: Global stromal context integration preserves classification accuracy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 100% patient concordance achieved without discriminative loss vs ConvFormer

title: MDFR-Net for enhanced feature refinement in aerial small object detection
task: Detect tiny objects in aerial imagery using multi-scale hierarchical attention
key_results: MDFR-Net improved detection on VisDrone and AI-TOD datasets; multi-seed experiments on VisDrone demonstrated stability; cross-dataset applicability shown
comments: Paper lacks specific quantitative performance numbers (mAP, recall) in abstract, limiting reproducibility assessment.

model_io.model: MDFR-Net with MHAF, ODFE, HCPF modules and P2 detection head
outputs: Object detections with bounding boxes and confidence scores

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hierarchical attention fusion and orientation decoupling improve small object detection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on VisDrone and AI-TOD; cross-dataset generalization demonstrated

title: Three-dimensional shape diversity of the fingertips and nails in Japanese adults
task: Quantify 3D morphological variation in fingertips and nails for forensic hand identification
key_results: PCA identified major shape variations including wide/narrow fingertip forms, nail embedding degree, and dorso-volar projection; strong correlations in interphalangeal segment lengths across digits
comments: Provides forensic anthropometry foundation but lacks discriminative power metrics needed to assess identification reliability in casework.

model_io.model: Principal Component Analysis on 3D homologous shape models

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hand shape variation follows interpretable geometric patterns useful for suspect exclusion
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; major contrasts between wide/narrow forms and nail configurations identified

title: Hierarchical AI classification of benign laryngeal disorders using acoustic voice features
task: Hierarchical machine learning framework for automated classification of benign laryngeal disorders
key_results: Hierarchical framework outperformed flat multiclass classifiers; Stage 1 integrated CNN mel-spectrograms with 21 acoustic features; confidence-aware triage improved performance by selective expert referral
comments: Well-designed clinical workflow mimicry but external validation remains essential before deployment; internal validation on single database limits generalizability.

model_io.model: Three-stage hierarchical CNN+features classifier with confidence-aware triage
inputs: 21 acoustic features (pitch, formants, jitter, shimmer, etc.)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hierarchical decomposition improves classification over flat multiclass approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; hierarchy outperformed HuBERT and HeAR

hypotheses.hypothesis: Confidence-aware referral maintains coverage while improving accuracy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; selective expert review improved diagnostic performance

title: SPOTnet: weakly-supervised specular reflection detection and removal for minimally invasive surgery
task: Detect and remove specular reflections in minimally invasive surgery using weakly supervised learning
key_results: SPOTnet IoU 0.613, recall 0.740, E-measure 0.963; outperformed EndoSRR and UnReflectAnything; specular removal improved downstream segmentation (F1 +26.9%, p<0.01); 88.9% surgeon-rated trustworthiness
comments: Excellent weakly-supervised approach enabling deployment without manual annotation; prospective surgeon evaluation strengthens clinical acceptance case.

model_io.model: SPOTnet: HSV-based exemplar library → U-Net training → LaMa inpainting pipeline
inputs: Minimally invasive surgical frames (24,306 TEMS frames)
HSV color-space detection with morphological refinement

hypotheses.hypothesis: Weakly supervised SR detection generalizes across surgical platforms without retraining
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cross-dataset generalization across four benchmarks without fine-tuning

hypotheses.hypothesis: SR removal improves downstream surgical computer vision

title: Linking geography, isolation source, and genomic diversity in a global Candida albicans phylogeny
task: Reconstruct global phylogeny of Candida albicans and link geographic/ecological factors to genomic diversity
key_results: 945 isolates analyzed; identified six novel clusters predominantly of admixed Asian isolates; >95% heterozygous at mating-type locus; 8% aneuploidy across phylogeny; intra-host analysis revealed predominantly clonal colonization with 14/95 individuals harboring multi-cluster isolates
comments: Thorough phylogenomic survey improving on prior work, but confounding between geography and isolation source limits causal inference.

model_io.model: Whole-genome phylogenetic analysis with agnostic threshold-based clustering
inputs: Phased genomes from 945 global C. albicans isolates (clinical/environmental)
Geographic origin and isolation source metadata

hypotheses.hypothesis: Geographic origin and isolation source independently structure C. albicans phylogeny
hypotheses.result: Both associated with cluster membership but confounded; region-specific isolation sources dominate

hypotheses.hypothesis: Isolates show predominantly clonal intra-host transmission
hypotheses.result: Confirmed for 81/95 individuals; 14 individuals harbored multi-cluster isolates indicating complex transmission

title: An inter-species hybrid in the emerging fungal pathogen Rhodosporidiobolus fluvialis
task: Identify inter-species hybrid in Rhodosporidiobolus fluvialis clinical isolates
key_results: One diploid isolate identified as allodiploid interspecies hybrid with two highly divergent subgenomes; one subgenome closely related to R. fluvialis, second from unsampled Rhodosporidiobolus species; limited recombination evidence
comments: Important example of pathogenic hybridization but limited to two isolates; characterization of unsampled parental species incomplete.

model_io.model: Whole-genome comparison and phylogenetic analysis (ITS and protein-coding genes)
inputs: Two clinical R. fluvialis isolate genome/read data (one diploid, one haploid)

hypotheses.hypothesis: High-divergence diploid R. fluvialis isolate represents inter-species hybrid
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; phylogenetics and subgenome divergence support allodiploid hybridization

title: Accelerating environmental health sciences through data and metadata standards to support FAIR principles
task: Develop data and metadata standards framework to support FAIR principles in environmental health sciences
key_results: Overview of existing EHS-relevant standards (public health initiatives, controlled vocabularies, ontologies, FAIR platforms); outlined practical adoption steps; highlighted AI/ML-ready data ecosystem benefits
comments: Important infrastructure perspective but lacks quantitative metrics demonstrating standards' impact on reproducibility or AI performance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Community adoption of data/metadata standards enables AI/ML-driven discovery in fragmented EHS domains

comments: Theoretical framework is innovative for multimode quantum light; experimental realization and measurement of cross-comb entanglement remain open.

key_results: Strain-induced entangled-to-packed crossover identified via MD; inter-chain stress contribution quantitatively captured beyond tube model predictions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tube model fails in strong extension due to inter-chain reorganization

title: Conveyor-mode electron shuttling through a T-junction in Si/SiGe

title: Atomically resolved exciton emission from single defects in MoS2

title: Dynamical analysis and optimal control of a Hyper-SICR rumor spreading model on hypergraphs

title: First-principles investigation of the electronic, optical, and mechanical properties of β-Si3N4 using rSCAN meta-GGA and DFT-D4 dispersion correction
task: First-principles DFT study of electronic, optical and mechanical properties of β-Si₃N₄
key_results: Band gap 5.029 eV (weakly indirect); elastic moduli B=263 GPa, G=135 GPa, E=346 GPa; strong UV absorption peaks at 17.46 eV and 17.79 eV
comments: Comprehensive computational study with good methodological rigor (rSCAN meta-GGA + DFT-D4), but lacks experimental validation; mechanical anisotropy is significant and well-characterized.

model_io.model: DFT (CASTEP) with rSCAN meta-GGA and DFT-D4 dispersion

hypotheses.hypothesis: Si–N orbital hybridization governs electronic and mechanical properties in hexagonal β-Si₃N₄
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via DOS analysis showing strong hybridization and consistent elastic anisotropy

title: A self-healing secure group communication framework for resource-constrained IoT devices using decentralised key management and trust-based voting
task: Secure group communication in resource-constrained IoT with insider threat detection
key_results: Packet delivery recovery from 43.7% to 93.4% against blackhole attacker; 22.4 s median isolation time; 6.4% energy overhead on Class 1 hardware
comments: Practical implementation on Contiki-NG is valuable, but trust-layer accuracy and false-positive rates under benign network failures need deeper analysis.

model_io.model: SecureGroup-IoT protocol (key hierarchy + trust voting + consensus eviction)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-watchdog consensus can detect and isolate malicious nodes without high overhead
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieved fast isolation with <7% energy penalty on constrained devices

title: Detector-optimized wavelength-hybrid entangled photon source for scalable fiber quantum key distribution
task: Wavelength-hybrid entangled photon source optimized for fiber QKD deployment
key_results: Polarization entanglement visibility 97.3% (H/V) and 94.9% (D/A); state fidelity ≥96.1%; spectral brightness 1.9×10³ pairs/s/mW/GHz over 300 GHz bandwidth
comments: Clever wavelength choice (680 nm + 1550 nm) addresses practical deployment bottlenecks; high-brightness SPDC design is well-optimized but ppKTP substrate cost and alignment sensitivity merit discussion.

model_io.model: Type-0 SPDC in crossed-crystal ppKTP pumped at 473 nm

hypotheses.hypothesis: Wavelength-hybrid design simultaneously addresses fiber loss, detector efficiency, and cost for practical QKD networks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; high fidelity and brightness enable scalable entanglement-based QKD nodes

title: A temporal graph transformer neural network for clustering influential control nodes in the controllability processes on of social internet of things networks
task: Clustering influential control nodes in temporal Social IoT networks via graph transformer
key_results: TGCIN achieves ~91% accuracy and ~92% F1-score; partitions nodes into critical drivers (few), bridging relays (intermediate), peripheral (majority)
comments: Novel application of graph transformers to controllability in temporal multilayer networks; interpretability is strong but comparison to recent graph neural network baselines would strengthen claims.

model_io.model: Temporal Graph Transformer Neural Network (TGCIN) on multilayer SIoT graph

hypotheses.hypothesis: Relation-aware spatial attention + temporal GRU encoder captures node influence evolution in controllability processes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; TGCIN outperforms baselines with fast convergence and interpretable clustering

title: Tailoring the nanoscale physicochemical properties of V2O5 thin films through Mn doping for enhanced electrochemical performance
task: Mn doping of V₂O₅ thin films for enhanced electrochemical energy storage
key_results: Mn 4% doped V₂O₅ achieves superior specific capacitance and charge-transfer kinetics; defect-state formation and oxygen vacancies confirmed via UV-Vis
comments: Electrochemical performance is promising, but cycle-life stability, self-discharge, and comparison to state-of-the-art supercapacitors are not addressed.

model_io.model: Sol-gel synthesized Mn-doped V₂O₅ thin film on ITO

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mn doping improves electrochemical performance by creating oxygen vacancies and defect states
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 4% Mn shows optimal balance of defects and electrical conductivity

title: Fractal basin geometry and the limits to predictability and reproducibility in deep learning
task: Riddled basin geometry as mechanism for irreproducibility in deep learning
key_results: Near-zero uncertainty exponent derived analytically for minimal networks; riddled basin signatures detected across multiple architectures; intertwined training destinations in deep networks
comments: Elegant dynamical systems perspective on a practical problem; analytical results limited to toy models but broader empirical validation across architectures strengthens generalizability claim.

model_io.model: Neural network training with random initialization ensemble

hypotheses.hypothesis: Riddled basin geometry (fat fractals at arbitrarily fine scales) explains irreproducibility independent of extrinsic randomness
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; near-zero exponent yields marginal gain from initialization precision improvements

title: Interplay of superconductivity and ferromagnetism in ferromagnetic-semiconductor-based Josephson junctions
task: Proximity superconductivity and Josephson effects in ferromagnetic-semiconductor heterostructures
key_results: Unconventional Fraunhofer patterns with asymmetric lobes, hysteresis, and flux jumps; broken time-reversal symmetry evidenced; gate-tunable supercurrents confirmed
comments: Materials platform is novel and clean, but the interpretation of nonreciprocal effects as ferromagnetism-induced versus edge-channel transport remains ambiguous.

model_io.model: Al/InAs/(Ga,Fe)Sb Josephson junction with perpendicular field

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ferromagnetic semiconductor induces broken time-reversal symmetry in proximity superconductivity
hypotheses.result: Supported; unconventional Fraunhofer patterns and asymmetric lobe evolution observed

title: Insect-inspired hexapod robot with magnetically coupled compliant and modular drive system
task: Magnetically coupled hexapod robot with compliance and modular drive
key_results: Cost of Transport 30; >90% autonomous recovery rate under vertical perturbations; tool-free leg replacement enabled
comments: Insect-inspired magnetic transmission is a clever mechanical simplification, but absolute performance benchmarks against other miniature legged robots are absent.

model_io.model: INSECTRON hexapod with magnetic micro-clutches and Hall-effect proprioception

hypotheses.hypothesis: Magnetic transmission with preflex-like passive adaptability enables damage tolerance without active control
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; robust recovery and CoT competitive with precision-engineered designs

title: Single-particle limit of a topological edge state in a locally resonant band gap
task: Single-particle localization of topological edge states via local resonance singularity in SSH-inspired metamaterial
key_results: Inverse participation ratio = 1 (theoretical maximum localization); single-particle mode realized below first band gap; robust over broad parameter range
comments: Elegant topological + resonant design; single-particle limit is conceptually clean but practical applications beyond demonstration remain speculative.

model_io.model: 1D SSH-inspired stiffness dimer with local resonator

hypotheses.hypothesis: Local resonance singularity collapses topological edge state onto single boundary particle when frequencies align
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; inverse participation ratio=1 achieved with tunable boundary conditions

title: Chimney-board metastructures for birefraction and asymmetric transmission of water waves
task: Birefraction and asymmetric transmission of water waves via chimney-board metastructure
key_results: Effective refractive index difference 1.55; refraction angle separation >40°; broadband asymmetric transmission demonstrated; harbor protection proof-of-concept
comments: First demonstration of birefraction in water waves is significant; asymmetric transmission design elegantly balances destructive wave blocking with internal wave escape.

model_io.model: Chimney-board metastructure for low-frequency water waves

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stratified beam transmission via chimney-board metastructure creates double-mode splitting enabling birefraction in water waves
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; high refractive index difference and broad operational bandwidth achieved

title: Effective enzyme engineering through modeling kinetic parameter changes upon mutations with geometric deep learning
task: Predict kinetic parameter changes (ΔkCat, ΔKm) upon enzyme mutations
key_results: DeltaCata achieved substantial performance improvements over existing methods on unseen enzymes; sGmOMT2 engineering achieved 7.0-fold improvement in catalytic efficiency for icaritin synthesis
comments: The shift from predicting absolute parameters to modeling deltas is clever and addresses a real training data bottleneck, though validation is limited to one industrial enzyme.

model_io.model: DeltaCata (Siamese geometric graph neural network)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exploiting protein structural geometry improves mutation effect prediction over sequence-only approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by superior performance on unseen enzyme scaffolds

hypotheses.hypothesis: Predicted beneficial mutations identified via deep mutational scanning will correlate with experimental outcomes
hypotheses.result: Validated through in silico screening experiments and sGmOMT2 engineering

title: Personalization and evaluation of human whole-body metabolic models and community microbiome models using Persephone
task: Personalize and integrate human whole-body metabolic models with microbiome community models
key_results: Persephone pipeline successfully processes 100 metagenomic samples in days-to-week timescale on modest hardware; enables investigation of human-microbiome co-metabolism and physiological parameter effects
comments: The democratization of WBM analysis is valuable but the computational cost (days-to-weeks per cohort) limits high-throughput personalization; validation against ground-truth metabolomic predictions is not discussed.

model_io.model: Persephone personalization and evaluation pipeline
inputs: metagenomic sequencing data or taxonomy tables

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physiological parameters such as body weight significantly influence predicted human metabolism

title: A microfluidic mother machine for high-throughput single-cell analysis of human leukemia T cells
task: Enable high-throughput single-cell tracking of T-cell proliferation dynamics
key_results: Microfluidic device successfully tracked human leukemia T-cells over multiple generations; cells employ sizer-like strategy with asymmetric volume division to regulate size variation
comments: CFD-optimized channel geometry elegantly addresses nutrient supply for non-adherent cells, though generalizability to other cell types remains to be demonstrated.

model_io.model: Mother machine microfluidic device with computational fluid dynamics optimization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Human leukemia T-cells regulate division through a sizer-like mechanism to compensate for stochastic size fluctuations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by multi-generational tracking showing asymmetric volume division strategy
